title: Hamar Pahad
lyrics:
Before the cities, before the noise
there were ridges calling with a quiet voice
Deodar shadows on a winding road
my grandmother singing where the river flowed

If you listen, the mountains breathe
slow and steady, beneath the leaves

हमर पहाड़, हमर पहाड़
ह्यूं की चादर, बुरांशि बहार
Hold them gently, hold them near
हमर पहाड़, हमर पहाड़

Glaciers whisper they are getting thin
forests remember where the fires have been
Every spring of water, every terraced field
is a wound that only kindness heals

If you listen, the mountains breathe
slow and steady, beneath the leaves

हमर पहाड़, हमर पहाड़
ह्यूं की चादर, बुरांशि बहार
Hold them gently, hold them near
हमर पहाड़, हमर पहाड़

धारा को पाणि, गाड़-गधेरा
काफल पाकि गे, घाम धार मा
यो माटि हमरि, यो हमरि ईजा
बचै दिया, सबै मिलि बेर

हमर पहाड़, हमर पहाड़
ह्यूं की चादर, बुरांशि बहार
For the world, for the ones who come after
हमर पहाड़, हमर पहाड़

हमर पहाड़
